actions.name: Remove Preinstalled Consumer Apps
actions.description: Remove preinstalled consumer apps: News, Weather, Solitaire, People, Maps, Feedback Hub, Get Help, Tips, To Do, Cortana, Mixed Reality Portal, Skype. Packages that are not installed are skipped.

actions.name: Remove Get Office Hub
actions.description: Remove the 'Get Office' promotional app that advertises Office 365

actions.name: Remove Your Phone / Phone Link
actions.description: Remove the Your Phone / Phone Link companion app

actions.name: Remove Mail and Calendar
actions.description: Remove the built-in Mail and Calendar app (microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps)

actions.name: Remove Windows Camera
actions.description: Remove the built-in Windows Camera app (Microsoft.WindowsCamera)

actions.name: Remove Alarms & Clock
actions.description: Remove the built-in Alarms & Clock app (Microsoft.WindowsAlarms)

actions.name: Remove Sound Recorder
actions.description: Remove the built-in Sound Recorder app (Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder)

actions.name: Remove Sticky Notes
actions.description: Remove the built-in Sticky Notes app (Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes)

actions.name: Remove Power Automate
actions.description: Remove the Power Automate Desktop app (Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop)

actions.name: Remove Xbox Apps
actions.description: Remove the Xbox app, Xbox TCUI and speech-to-text overlay. The Game Bar overlay is kept because Windows uses it to register games (Game Mode depends on that).
actions.warningMessage: Breaks the Xbox app, PC Game Pass and Microsoft Store games that use Xbox sign-in. Reinstalling requires the Microsoft Store.

actions.name: Remove Social Media Apps
actions.description: Remove preinstalled Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn, Flipboard

actions.name: Remove Streaming App Trials
actions.description: Remove preinstalled Spotify, Hulu, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, Netflix, iHeartRadio

actions.name: Remove Preinstalled Games
actions.description: Remove King games (Candy Crush, Farm Heroes, Bubble Witch), Disney Magic Kingdoms, Asphalt, Hidden City, FarmVille, Caesars Slots

actions.name: Remove OEM Utility Bloat
actions.description: Remove preinstalled third-party utilities: Adobe Express, Duolingo, Fitbit, Drawboard PDF, CyberLink, Autodesk SketchBook

actions.name: Remove Amazon & Shopping Apps
actions.description: Remove the preinstalled Amazon shopping app (Prime Video is handled by the streaming-trials action)

actions.name: Remove Extended Microsoft Bloat
actions.description: Remove additional Microsoft apps: Clipchamp, Journal, PC Manager, Teams (consumer, old and new), Dev Home, Quick Assist, News, OneNote (store), Sway, OneConnect, 3D Builder, 3D Viewer, Paint 3D, Network Speed Test, Power BI, Movies & TV, Family, Print 3D, Messaging and the old Bing apps.

actions.name: Remove Copilot App
actions.description: Remove the Microsoft Copilot app package (Microsoft.Copilot). On Windows 11 24H2+ this is the only effective way to get rid of Copilot; the old TurnOffWindowsCopilot policy no longer applies to the app.

actions.name: Disable Edge Auto-Updates
actions.description: Prevent Edge from auto-updating and reinstalling itself via the Microsoft Edge Update service. Registry policy only — does not remove Edge.
actions.warningMessage: Edge Update also updates the WebView2 runtime used by many apps (including oudenOS). With it disabled, Edge and WebView2 stop receiving security updates until you re-enable it.

actions.name: Disable Edge Preloading & Background
actions.description: Prevent Edge from preloading at startup, running startup boost, and staying resident in background when closed. Registry policy only.

actions.name: Disable Edge Default Browser Prompts
actions.description: Stop Edge from prompting users to set it as the default browser and showing first-run experience screens.

actions.name: Remove Microsoft Edge
actions.description: Permanently uninstall Microsoft Edge (the browser). The WebView2 runtime is NOT touched. Uses the installer's force-uninstall flag after creating the stub file the installer requires, then removes the AppX provisioning so it is not reinstalled. Your Edge profile folder is left in place.
actions.warningMessage: This permanently removes Microsoft Edge. It cannot be undone from within Windows — you must download Edge from microsoft.com to reinstall. Some Windows features that open web links via Edge (Help, Feedback, some Settings pages) will fail to open. Ensure you have an alternative browser installed before proceeding.

actions.name: Remove New Bloatlook
actions.description: Remove the new Outlook bloat Windows app that replaces Mail & Calendar

actions.name: Remove the Recall Optional Feature
actions.description: Disable the "Recall" Windows optional feature with Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature, run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (PowerShell 7 can hang in DISM). Skipped when the feature is not present.
actions.warningMessage: Not automatically reversible. To restore: Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName "Recall" (then restart).

actions.name: Disable Connected User Experiences (DiagTrack)
actions.description: Disable the Connected User Experiences and Telemetry service (DiagTrack) — primary Windows telemetry pipeline

actions.name: Disable WAP Push Message Routing
actions.description: Disable dmwappushservice — routes telemetry data from DiagTrack to Microsoft

actions.name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
actions.description: Disable the SysMain service (formerly Superfetch) which preloads frequently used applications into memory

actions.name: Disable Windows Insider Service
actions.description: Disable wisvc — Windows Insider Program flight/preview management

actions.name: Disable Retail Demo Service
actions.description: Disable RetailDemo — retail store demo experience management

actions.name: Disable Downloaded Maps Manager
actions.description: Disable MapsBroker — the offline-maps download manager

actions.name: Disable Diagnostics Hub Standard Collector
actions.description: Disable diagnosticshub.standardcollector.service — the ETW trace collector used by Visual Studio diagnostics

actions.name: Disable Diagnostic Execution Service (diagsvc)
actions.description: Disable diagsvc, the service that runs scenario-based diagnostics
actions.warningMessage: The built-in 'Get Help / Troubleshoot' automated wizards (legacy MSDT troubleshooters) may not run while this is off. Re-enable if you need a Windows troubleshooter.

actions.name: Disable Print Spooler
actions.description: Disable Print Spooler — manages print queues. Safe to disable on systems with no printers.

actions.name: Disable Remote Access Services
actions.description: Disable Remote Desktop, Remote Registry, and Remote Assistance — external connection listeners

actions.name: Disable Xbox Background Services
actions.description: Disable Xbox Live Auth (XblAuthManager), Game Save, Networking, and Accessory services
actions.warningMessage: Breaks Xbox app and PC Game Pass sign-in, cloud saves and Xbox multiplayer, including some Game Pass titles. Only for PCs that never use Xbox, Game Pass or Store games. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable Fax Service
actions.description: Disable the Fax service — legacy fax modem support

actions.name: Disable Phone Service
actions.description: Disable PhoneSvc — telephony state management for Your Phone / Phone Link

actions.name: Disable Wallet Service
actions.description: Disable WalletService — NFC tap-to-pay and wallet credential management

actions.name: Disable Bluetooth Support Service
actions.description: Disable bthserv — Bluetooth device discovery and pairing

actions.name: Disable Geolocation Service
actions.description: Disable lfsvc — Windows location framework service

actions.name: Disable Windows Media Player Network Sharing
actions.description: Disable WMPNetworkSvc — DLNA/UPnP media server

actions.name: Disable Smart Card Services
actions.description: Disable SCardSvr and ScDeviceEnum — smart card reader support

actions.name: Disable Secondary Logon
actions.description: Disable seclogon — 'Run as different user' support

actions.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting Service
actions.description: Disable WerSvc — crash dump collection and upload

actions.name: Disable Data Usage (DusmSvc)
actions.description: Disable DusmSvc — the Data Usage Subscription Management service that meters per-network data usage
actions.warningMessage: Settings > Network > Data usage stops showing per-network statistics. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable Windows Biometric Service (WbioSrvc)
actions.description: Disable WbioSrvc — only do this on a machine with NO fingerprint reader or face camera
actions.warningMessage: Disabling WbioSrvc breaks Windows Hello fingerprint and face sign-in. Only disable on a system with NO fingerprint reader or biometric camera — otherwise you lose that sign-in method (PIN/password still work). Reversible.

actions.name: Disable Telemetry Collector Tasks
actions.description: Disable the Compatibility Appraiser (both the old and the 24H2 "Exp" name), ProgramDataUpdater, StartupAppTask and the CEIP Consolidator/UsbCeip tasks. Tasks that do not exist on this build are skipped.

actions.name: Disable Diagnostic Data Tasks
actions.description: Disable the disk diagnostic data collector and disk-footprint diagnostics tasks (Storage Sense and the memory diagnostic are left alone)

actions.name: Disable Error Report Queue Task
actions.description: Disable the Windows Error Reporting QueueReporting task that uploads queued crash reports

actions.name: Disable Windows Defender Scheduled Scans
actions.description: Disable Defender's scheduled scan, cache maintenance, cleanup and verification tasks. Real-time protection and manual scans are not affected.
actions.warningMessage: Defender will no longer run its periodic full scans or signature verification on a schedule. Run scans manually.

actions.name: Disable Offline Maps Tasks
actions.description: Disable offline map data download and update tasks

actions.name: Disable Speech Model Download Task
actions.description: Disable the background speech-model download task

actions.name: Disable Feature Usage Reporting Tasks
actions.description: Disable the FeatureConfig usage-data reporting/flushing tasks and the OneSettings refresh task

actions.name: Disable Power Efficiency Diagnostics
actions.description: Disable AnalyzeSystem — background power efficiency diagnostic collection

actions.name: Disable Device Census
actions.description: Disable Device Census — hardware/software inventory collection for Microsoft

actions.name: Set Diagnostic Data to Minimum
actions.description: Set diagnostic data to the minimum allowed level and limit diagnostic log/dump collection and feedback notifications. AllowTelemetry=0 (Security) is honored only on Enterprise, Education, IoT and Server; Home/Pro clamp it to Required.

actions.name: Disable Customer Experience Program
actions.description: Opt out of Microsoft Customer Experience Improvement Program

actions.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
actions.description: Disable automatic error report submission to Microsoft

actions.name: Disable Advertising ID
actions.description: Reset and disable the Windows advertising identifier

actions.name: Opt Out of PowerShell Telemetry
actions.description: Set POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT environment variable

actions.name: Disable Typing Insights
actions.description: Disable typing analytics collection

actions.name: Disable MSRT Windows Update Delivery
actions.description: Prevent Malicious Software Removal Tool from being offered via Windows Update

actions.name: Disable Telemetry Event Transcript Logging
actions.description: Stop Windows writing the local EventTranscript.db diagnostic event log, and stop OneSettings policy downloads that can re-arm telemetry

actions.name: Block Apps From Reading Other Apps' Diagnostic Info
actions.description: Force-deny the App Privacy 'diagnostic information' capability so Store apps can't query diagnostic/usage data about other running apps
actions.warningMessage: Apps that legitimately read cross-app diagnostic/usage info (some hardware monitors, game-overlay stats panels) may lose that data. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable Online Font Providers (Font Streaming)
actions.description: Stop Windows contacting Microsoft to stream/download missing fonts on demand
actions.warningMessage: Documents or web pages referencing a font you don't have installed fall back to a substitute instead of downloading it. Takes effect after a reboot (or restarting the Font Cache service).

actions.name: Disable Sync Your Settings to Microsoft Account
actions.description: Turn off roaming of Windows settings to your Microsoft account (Windows 10 only; Windows 11 replaced this with Windows Backup)
actions.warningMessage: Settings (theme, language, some credentials, accessibility) will no longer roam to your other Windows devices, and the 'Sync your settings' page is locked off. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable App Launch Tracking
actions.description: Stop tracking which apps you open for Start menu personalization

actions.name: Disable Tailored Experiences
actions.description: Stop Microsoft from using diagnostic data for personalized tips and ads

actions.name: Disable Online Tips
actions.description: Disable online tips and help content from Microsoft

actions.name: Lock Down Brave Extras (if installed)
actions.description: Brave browser policies: turn off Rewards, Wallet, VPN, Leo AI chat, News, Talk, Tor windows, usage pings, P3A, URL-keyed data collection, extended Safe Browsing reporting and metrics reporting. Harmless when Brave is not installed.

actions.name: Disable Clipboard History & Cloud Sync
actions.description: Disable Windows clipboard history and cross-device clipboard synchronization

actions.name: Disable Activity History & Timeline
actions.description: Stop Windows publishing and uploading activity history. The activity feed itself is left on because turning it off also breaks clipboard history (winutil d1a6179).

actions.name: Disable Cloud Content & Suggestions
actions.description: Disable Microsoft consumer features (auto-installed suggested apps), Spotlight-style cloud content, account-state content and third-party suggestions via policy

actions.name: Disable Location Services
actions.description: Disable Windows location services to prevent location tracking

actions.name: Disable Cross-Device Experiences (CDP)
actions.description: Turn off the Connected Devices Platform behind Phone Link, Nearby Share, and cross-device handoff

actions.name: Block Firmware-Injected Programs (WPBT)
actions.description: Stop Windows running executables that the motherboard firmware injects through the Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) — used by some vendors to auto-install utilities such as Armoury Crate.

actions.name: Disable Input Personalization
actions.description: Disable implicit text and ink collection used for input personalization

actions.name: Disable Online Speech Recognition
actions.description: Opt out of online speech recognition data collection

actions.name: Disable Touch Input Collection
actions.description: Disable touch keyboard and handwriting data collection

actions.name: Disable Contact Harvesting
actions.description: Prevent trained data store from harvesting contacts for input prediction

actions.name: Disable Feedback Frequency
actions.description: Set Windows feedback solicitation frequency to never

actions.name: Disable Find My Device
actions.description: Disable the Find My Device location tracking feature

actions.name: Disable SmartScreen Filter
actions.description: Disable the Windows SmartScreen filter that checks downloaded files and visited websites against Microsoft's reputation database
actions.warningMessage: Downloaded programs are no longer reputation-checked before they run. Only turn this off if you understand the risk. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable Windows Recall
actions.description: Disable the Windows Recall AI feature that captures screen activity
actions.warningMessage: AllowRecallEnablement=0 also removes the Recall component; re-enabling it later needs the optional feature to be downloaded again.

actions.name: Disable Click to Do
actions.description: Disable the AI-powered Click to Do overlay feature

actions.name: Disable Windows AI Fabric Service
actions.description: Disable the WSAIFabricSvc service (present only on some Windows 11 24H2+ builds; skipped when absent)

actions.name: Hide AI Components Settings Page
actions.description: Hide the 'AI components' page from the Windows Settings app. This is cosmetic/control only — it removes the AI settings entry but does not disable any AI service by itself. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable Edge AI Features
actions.description: Disable Copilot integration, AI sidebar, and AI-powered features in Microsoft Edge

actions.name: Disable Paint AI Features
actions.description: Disable AI-powered Cocreator, Image Creator, and Generative tools in Paint

actions.name: Disable Notepad AI Features
actions.description: Disable AI-powered text generation and rewriting in Notepad

actions.name: Block System AI Model Access
actions.description: Stop apps from using on-device generative AI models system-wide

actions.name: Disable Sticky Keys Shortcut
actions.description: Disable the Shift×5 sticky keys shortcut that interrupts gameplay

actions.name: Stop Windows Update Installing Drivers
actions.description: Stop Windows Update and device setup from downloading drivers and device metadata. Install GPU, chipset and other drivers yourself afterwards.
actions.warningMessage: New hardware will not get drivers automatically, and you are responsible for driver updates (including security fixes).

actions.name: Disable Automatic Maintenance
actions.description: Disable Windows Automatic Maintenance scheduler
actions.warningMessage: Scheduled drive optimization (SSD TRIM) and other maintenance stop. Run Optimize Drives manually from time to time.

actions.name: Disable Auto-Restart Sign-On
actions.description: Prevent Windows from auto-signing in after restart

actions.name: Disable Store Auto-Updates
actions.description: Prevent Microsoft Store from automatically downloading app updates
actions.warningMessage: Store apps stop updating automatically, including security fixes. Update them from the Store manually.

actions.name: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap
actions.description: Turn off the Fault Tolerant Heap, which silently applies heap mitigations to apps that crash repeatedly

actions.name: Disable Memory Compression
actions.description: Disable the Windows memory compression agent that compresses idle pages instead of writing to page file

actions.name: Disable Prefetch
actions.description: Disable Prefetch/ReadyBoot subsystem that preloads application data on boot

actions.name: Optimize Svchost Split Threshold
actions.description: Stop Windows from splitting services into separate svchost.exe processes by raising the split threshold above your RAM size (0xFFFFFFFF). Fewer processes, slightly less memory.
actions.warningMessage: May leave Xbox accessory services (controllers) stuck on "Starting" and reduces service isolation. Reversible.

actions.name: Increase TDR Timeout to 10 Seconds
actions.description: Increase the Timeout Detection and Recovery (TDR) delay from the default 2 seconds to 10 seconds, preventing false GPU resets during heavy load spikes

actions.name: Disable Game DVR Background Recording
actions.description: Turn off Game DVR / background capture (the "record what happened" buffer). Game Bar itself stays installed and usable.

actions.name: Prefer Exclusive Fullscreen (system-wide FSO off)
actions.description: Set the system-wide GameConfigStore values that make fullscreen games prefer exclusive fullscreen over fullscreen optimizations. A game's own compatibility setting still wins.

actions.name: Disable Window Transparency Effects
actions.description: Disable window transparency effects (acrylic, blur) that use GPU compositing for translucent title bars and taskbar

actions.name: Disable Nvidia Container Services
actions.description: Disable NVDisplay.ContainerLocalSystem and NvContainerLocalSystem background services that run telemetry, overlay, and update checks.
actions.warningMessage: Disabling the NVIDIA display container (NVDisplay.ContainerLocalSystem) breaks NVIDIA Control Panel and NVIDIA App features; the overlay, recording and automatic driver updates also stop. Re-enable the services to get them back.

actions.name: Disable AMD Background Services
actions.description: Disable the AMD Crash Defender and AMD User Experience Program launcher services
actions.warningMessage: AMD crash reporting and the UX-program launcher stop. Adrenalin and FreeSync keep working.

actions.name: Disable CPU Core Parking
actions.description: Set the minimum number of unparked cores to 100% on AC power in the active power plan, so Windows never parks cores.

actions.name: Aggressive Processor Boost Mode
actions.description: Set processor performance boost policy to Aggressive (mode 2). This prioritizes sustained maximum turbo frequency over power efficiency.

actions.name: Set Minimum Processor State to 100% (current plan)
actions.description: Hold the active power plan's minimum (and maximum) processor state at 100% on AC power. Does not switch power plans and does not mean 100% CPU usage, but raises idle power draw, heat and fan noise.

actions.name: Disable Fast Startup (Hybrid Shutdown)
actions.description: Disable Windows Fast Startup (hybrid shutdown) which hibernates the kernel session instead of performing a full shutdown

actions.name: Disable Hibernation
actions.description: Turn off Windows hibernation, hide the Hibernate option from the power menu, and reclaim the hiberfil.sys disk space (roughly 40-75% of your RAM) after the next restart

actions.name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
actions.description: Disable USB selective suspend in the active power plan (AC power), so Windows does not power down idle USB devices

actions.name: Disable PCIe Link State Power Management
actions.description: Disable Active State Power Management (ASPM) transitions on PCIe devices, preventing the system from placing the PCIe bus in low-power link states (L0s, L1)

actions.name: Disable Modern Standby
actions.description: Disable Modern Standby (S0 Low Power Idle) to force legacy S3 sleep. Prevents network activity, background updates, and battery drain during sleep.
actions.warningMessage: Changes sleep behavior from Modern Standby to legacy S3. Instant wake and background sync will no longer work. Verify sleep works correctly after reboot.

actions.name: Disable Device Power Saving (all devices)
actions.description: Clear "Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power" on every device that exposes it (MSPower_DeviceEnable). Desktops only.
actions.warningMessage: Not automatically reversible: to undo, re-tick "Allow the computer to turn off this device" in Device Manager for the affected devices.

actions.name: Disable CPU Power Throttling (EcoQoS)
actions.description: Stop Windows down-clocking threads it classifies as background work (EcoQoS power throttling)
actions.warningMessage: Increases power draw and heat because background threads no longer down-clock — not recommended on battery-powered laptops. The gain on a pure foreground workload is small. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable NTFS Last Access Timestamp
actions.description: Stop NTFS from writing a last-access timestamp every time a file is read (System-Managed, Last Access Disabled — fsutil flag 0x80000001). This is the single owner of this setting; reversible.

actions.name: Disable Windows Search Indexing Service
actions.description: Disable the Windows Search indexing service (WSearch) which continuously scans and indexes file contents in the background
actions.warningMessage: Start menu, File Explorer and Outlook searches become much slower without the index. Reversible.

actions.name: Turn Off Write-Cache Buffer Flushing
actions.description: Enable write caching and mark SCSI/NVMe disks as power-protected so Windows stops flushing the write cache (CacheIsPowerProtected=1). Only for PCs on a UPS or with very reliable power.
actions.warningMessage: A power cut or hard crash can lose or corrupt recently written data. Only use with a UPS or very reliable power. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable NTFS 8.3 Short-Name Creation
actions.description: Stop NTFS creating DOS-style 8.3 short names for new files (same as fsutil 8dot3name set 1). Existing short names are kept.

actions.name: Disable Mouse Pointer Acceleration
actions.description: Set mouse acceleration to 1:1 (6/11 speed, no acceleration curve)

actions.name: Hide Task View Button
actions.description: Remove the Task View button from the taskbar

actions.name: Disable Widgets (policy)
actions.description: Turn off Widgets with the supported AllowNewsAndInterests policy, which also removes the taskbar button. On current Windows 11 builds Windows may block third-party tools from changing this setting; if oudenOS reports it as skipped, turn Widgets off in Settings > Personalization > Taskbar. The policy may be ignored on Windows 11 Home.
actions.warningMessage: Windows may block this change on current Windows 11 builds (reported as skipped). In that case turn Widgets off in Settings > Personalization > Taskbar. May be ignored on Windows 11 Home.

actions.name: Show Search as an Icon (policy)
actions.description: Set the SearchOnTaskbarMode policy to 1 (search icon only). Documented values: 0 hide, 1 icon only, 2 icon and label, 3 search box. Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100) and later.

actions.name: Disable Windows Copilot (Win11)
actions.description: Turn off the built-in Copilot sidebar and its taskbar button (Windows 11 23H2 and earlier; on 24H2 Copilot is an app — use Remove Copilot App)

actions.name: Hide Teams Chat Icon
actions.description: Remove the Teams Chat icon from the taskbar

actions.name: Enable End Task in Taskbar
actions.description: Show End Task option when right-clicking apps on the taskbar

actions.name: Hide Meet Now
actions.description: Hide the Meet Now icon from the system tray (Windows 10 only)

actions.name: Show Search as an Icon (per-user setting)
actions.description: Set the per-user SearchboxTaskbarMode value to 1 (icon only). On current Windows 11 builds Windows may block third-party tools from changing it (reported as skipped); then change it in Settings > Personalization > Taskbar.

actions.name: Remove 'Cast to Device'
actions.description: Remove Cast to Device from right-click menu

actions.name: Remove 'Troubleshoot compatibility'
actions.description: Remove compatibility troubleshooter from .exe right-click

actions.name: Remove 'Edit with Paint 3D'
actions.description: Hide the Paint 3D context-menu entry (Paint 3D is no longer shipped on 24H2)

actions.name: Disable Search Highlights
actions.description: Remove trending and promotional content from Windows Search

actions.name: Disable Search History
actions.description: Disable device search history used for search suggestions

actions.name: Show File Extensions
actions.description: Show file extensions in File Explorer for all file types

actions.name: Show Hidden Files
actions.description: Display hidden files and folders in File Explorer

actions.name: Open Explorer to This PC
actions.description: Set File Explorer to open to This PC instead of Home/Quick Access

actions.name: Hide Home and Gallery in Explorer
actions.description: Hide the Home and Gallery entries in the File Explorer navigation pane (winutil RemoveHomeAndGallery). Pair it with "Open Explorer to This PC".

actions.name: Enable Long File Paths
actions.description: Allow paths longer than 260 characters for apps that support it (LongPathsEnabled=1)

actions.name: Disable Web Search in Start
actions.description: Remove Bing web results from Windows Search

actions.name: Disable Lock Screen Tips
actions.description: Remove tips and ads from the Windows lock screen

actions.name: Disable Start Menu Suggestions
actions.description: Remove app suggestions and recommendations from the Start menu

actions.name: Disable Content Delivery Subscriptions
actions.description: Remove all Windows content delivery ads — welcome experience, tips, suggested content

actions.name: Disable Account Notifications
actions.description: Remove Microsoft account and setup nag notifications

actions.name: Disable Suggested & Backup Notifications
actions.description: Remove Windows toast notifications for suggestions and backup reminders

actions.name: Disable Sync Provider Notifications
actions.description: Remove OneDrive and sync provider ads from File Explorer

actions.name: Disable Phone Link Suggestions
actions.description: Remove Phone Link opt-in prompts and mobility suggestions

actions.name: Disable Desktop Spotlight
actions.description: Remove the Learn about this picture desktop spotlight overlay

actions.name: Disable Edge Ads & Suggestions
actions.description: Remove ads, shopping, recommendations, and promotional content from Microsoft Edge

actions.name: Block Store Apps From Running in the Background (policy)
actions.description: Force-deny background execution for Store/UWP apps via the LetAppsRunInBackground policy. Windows 11 removed the global toggle, so the policy is the supported way. May be ignored on Windows 11 Home.
actions.warningMessage: Store apps (Phone Link, Mail, Teams etc.) stop syncing and notifying in the background. If Explorer right-click menus misbehave on 24H2, revert this. Reversible.

actions.name: Disable Cortana / Search Assistant Policy
actions.description: Set AllowCortana=0 (paired with the web-search policy as PC-Tuning recommends)

actions.name: Disable AutoPlay & AutoRun
actions.description: Disable automatic media playback and program execution when inserting removable drives

actions.name: Keep Game Mode On
actions.description: Make sure Game Mode is enabled (the Windows default) — sets both AllowAutoGameMode and AutoGameModeEnabled

actions.name: Disable Cloud Notification Network Usage
actions.description: Block Windows Push Notification System from making network calls to Microsoft cloud servers for notification delivery
actions.warningMessage: Apps that rely on cloud push (Teams, Phone Link, mail apps) stop receiving notifications while closed. Local notifications still work.

actions.name: Decrease Shutdown Time
actions.description: Reduce app kill timeouts for faster shutdown. Does NOT auto-end tasks — Windows will still ask before killing hung apps.

actions.name: Shorten Service Shutdown Timeout
actions.description: Lower WaitToKillServiceTimeout to 3 seconds so services that hang at shutdown are stopped sooner. Does not force-close your apps.

actions.name: Disable LLMNR
actions.description: Disable Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution — prevents NTLM hash capture attacks

actions.name: Disable Hypervisor-enforced Code Integrity
actions.description: Disable HVCI (Hypervisor-enforced Code Integrity) which validates kernel-mode code integrity using the hypervisor, adding overhead to every driver load and some system calls
actions.warningMessage: Memory Integrity protects the kernel from malicious or vulnerable drivers. Vanguard (Valorant/League) and FACEIT may refuse to run without HVCI, TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot. Reversible: turn Memory Integrity back on in Windows Security > Device security > Core isolation.

actions.name: Disable CPU Microcode Mitigations (Spectre/Meltdown)
actions.description: Disable Spectre/Meltdown CPU mitigations by renaming the microcode update DLLs. Affects mcupdate_GenuineIntel.dll (Intel) or mcupdate_AuthenticAMD.dll (AMD). Requires TrustedInstaller privileges.
actions.warningMessage: Exposes the system to Spectre/Meltdown-class attacks, can be slower on newer CPUs, and FACEIT requires the mitigations. Requires TrustedInstaller. Revert if it does not help.

actions.name: Disable Early Access Updates
actions.description: Prevent Windows from opting in to early access / continuous innovation updates

actions.name: Disable Delivery Optimization
actions.description: Disable peer-to-peer Windows Update delivery that uses your bandwidth for other PCs

actions.name: Prevent Windows Update Auto-Restart
actions.description: Prevent Windows Update from automatically restarting the PC when a user is logged on by setting NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers to 1

actions.name: Defer Feature Updates by 365 Days
actions.description: Defer Windows feature updates by 365 days, allowing only security and quality updates to install while postponing major version upgrades

actions.name: Stay on the Current Windows Version
actions.description: Pin Windows to the version you are running now (TargetReleaseVersion + ProductVersion + TargetReleaseVersionInfo read from DisplayVersion). Security and quality updates keep installing; feature upgrades are held. May be ignored on Windows 11 Home.
actions.warningMessage: Not automatically reversible. To undo, delete TargetReleaseVersion, ProductVersion and TargetReleaseVersionInfo under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate. Remove the pin before your version reaches end of support.

actions.name: Turn Off Automatic Windows Updates
actions.description: Set the NoAutoUpdate policy so Windows Update never downloads or installs updates on its own. You must check for updates manually.
actions.warningMessage: Security updates no longer install automatically. Check Windows Update manually and regularly. Reversible.

actions.name: Turn Off Defender Real-Time Protection (policy)
actions.description: Set the Defender real-time protection policies (real-time monitoring, behaviour monitoring, on-access, downloads/attachments (IOAV) and scan-on-enable). Microsoft Defender ignores these policies while Tamper Protection is on, which is the default (the change may appear to succeed but has no effect) — turn Tamper Protection off in Windows Security first.
actions.warningMessage: Removes real-time malware protection. Ignored while Tamper Protection is on. Some anti-cheats may expect Defender running. Reversible (policy values are restored on rollback).

actions.name: Disable Defender Cloud Protection
actions.description: Turn off Defender cloud-delivered protection (MAPS) and automatic sample submission via policy. Ignored while Tamper Protection is on.
actions.warningMessage: New threats that only cloud protection would catch may be missed. Ignored while Tamper Protection is on. Reversible.

actions.name: Turn Off Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) and Credential Guard
actions.description: Request VBS off: EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity=0 (system and policy), Memory Integrity off, and Credential Guard off (LsaCfgFlags=0 in both locations — Credential Guard is on by default on Windows 11 22H2+ Enterprise/Education). Needs a reboot. Hyper-V, WSL2, Windows Sandbox or Virtual Machine Platform keep the hypervisor running.
actions.warningMessage: Weakens credential and kernel protection. If Credential Guard/VBS was enabled with a UEFI lock, these values are ignored: Microsoft's documented way out is the SecConfig.efi boot entry (loadoptions DISABLE-LSA-ISO) confirmed at the keyboard on the next boot; disabling SVM/VT-x in the firmware is the fallback. Riot's support pages say Vanguard may require Memory Integrity (HVCI/VBS), TPM 2.0, Secure Boot and IOMMU depending on the system, and VALORANT's optional On-Demand Vanguard mode requires VBS + HVCI; FACEIT may require them too (THE FINALS requires Secure Boot). Reversible unless UEFI-locked.

actions.name: Disable Vulnerable Driver Blocklist
actions.description: Disable the Microsoft Vulnerable Driver Blocklist that prevents certain drivers from loading
actions.warningMessage: Allows potentially vulnerable drivers to load. Only disable if you need specific kernel tools like RW-Everything for XHCI IMOD or MSI utility.
